name: American River (Lower / Sacramento)

gaugeContext.note: The Fair Oaks gauge measures the American River upstream of Lower Sunrise. Dam releases and conditions can change during a trip; this reading is reference flow, not a calibrated travel-time model.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — American River at Fair Oaks, station 11446500

timing.note: A local raft operator publishes seasonal trip guidance. No reviewed relationship between flow, craft and travel speed is available; published guide time is not a live ETA.

blurb: A popular Sacramento-area summer raft float from Lower Sunrise to River Bend Park. Mostly gentle water includes San Juan Rapids; releases, current and takeout conditions vary.

sections.notes: Arrange your shuttle before launching. Enter River Bend Park from Rod Beaudry Drive off Folsom Boulevard. River Bend is a gravel-beach takeout, not a paved boat ramp. Public park access and a rental check-in are different destinations; confirm seasonal shuttle service and the endpoint with your operator.

guideTimes.conditions: American River Raft Rentals’ seasonal Sunrise-to-River Bend raft-trip guide. Flow, paddling and stops change travel time. This is not a forecast for today or a separate kayak or tube estimate.

notices.title: San Juan Rapids and changing flows
notices.text: This float includes Class II San Juan Rapids. Check releases and local conditions, and scout unfamiliar rapids. The seasonal raft guide does not establish suitable winter or high-water conditions.
notices.sourceName: American River Raft Rentals — Sunrise route and rapids

notices.title: Check park access before your trip
notices.text: County parks open from sunrise to sunset and charge parking fees. Check current closures and set your shuttle before launching.

putInAccess.sourceName: Sacramento County Regional Parks — Sunrise Recreation Areas
putInAccess.note: The county documents Lower Sunrise as a summer raft launch. The unchanged state DBW facility coordinate is beside the bridge approach, not a checked water-edge launch. Keep it as an approximate access area; do not snap it to the river. Satellite imagery reviewed on 2026-11-03.
putInAccess.directions: Enter from Sunrise Boulevard just south of the American River bridge. After the park kiosk, turn left for Lower Sunrise and follow signs to the raft launch. Parking fees apply. This is not the separate Upper Sunrise boat ramp.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: CDFW Lower American River Geographic Response Plan, April 2025, AME-160; Sacramento County Regional Parks
takeOutAccess.note: County park page confirms a public rafting take-out. CDFW April 2025 plan printed pages 71–73 provides this coordinate, sand/gravel access description and 2022 landing photographs. Satellite review on 2026-11-03 matches the coordinate to the photographed river-left beach and access trail. This is a source-reviewed landing, not a new field survey; the water edge varies with flow. Public road entrance is Rod Beaudry Drive. Response-only vehicle/gate access is not public ramp permission.
takeOutAccess.directions: Enter River Bend Park from Rod Beaudry Drive off Folsom Boulevard and follow park signs. Parking fees apply. Do not use the response plan’s nearby residential address as an entrance or assume vehicle access through a locked gate.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: CDFW Lower American River GRP, AME-160 site photographs, printed page 72
takeOutAccess.bankNote: The 2022 site photographs explicitly label the takeout beach RL while looking upstream and downstream; river left means facing downstream. Current imagery confirms the beach on the same bank.

mapAuditNote: Lower Sunrise public access verified as an approximate facility area; River Bend landing and downstream bank reviewed from county/CDFW evidence and imagery. Main-channel line and exact Lower Sunrise connection reviewed separately.
